CustomField.description: Sales Agreement this Order counts towards when it is dated after the agreement's native EndDate. The platform refuses Order.SalesAgreementId outside StartDate-EndDate (FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION, grace days do not help), so extension-month releases carry this link instead. Exactly one of SalesAgreementId and this field is set on a release.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set when the Order is dated after the agreement's native end; it counts in the agreement's extension actuals.
CustomField.label: Sales Agreement (Extension)
